effective_date_basis: The date of sale from the Custodian's reports; otherwise a stated gap.
ending_pattern: The order authorizes one disposition of specified property seized under the Trading with the Enemy Act. It is spent when the sale or disposition is completed.

exceptions_savings.assessment: The transfer of title is an accrued effect; claims under later settlement acts are independent.

exemplar.wpa_summary: Alien Property Custodian authorized to sellat private sale certain specifiedstock of the U. S. Metals Refining Co., formerly the property of the Nationalbank fur Deutschland (Darmstadter und Nationalbank) of Berlin,Germany.

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
The order prescribes general rules for the Custodian.
Not mapped to the 1921 war-end resolution: the Trading with the Enemy Act is reported to be excepted from it.
